menya-zapomnyat.title: They Will Remember Me
menya-zapomnyat.description: Hoodies carrying GADYUKA's tattoo graphics: the snake coiled around the «Г», a face-on snake head, scales, and an oversized head across the back. The slogan «They Will Remember Me» is on every piece.

hoodie-white-logo.title: Sign Hoodie — White
hoodie-white-logo.description: A white hoodie bearing the brand's signature mark: an engraved snake, jaws open, coiled around the letter «Г». Finished with «ГАДЮКА / They Will Remember Me» at the hem.
hoodie-white-logo.details:
Print: the logo — snake and letter «Г»
«ГАДЮКА / They Will Remember Me» lettering at the hem
Signature hang tag with the red tongue
Ask about fabric and sizes when ordering

hoodie-white-head.title: Face-On Hoodie — White
hoodie-white-head.description: A white hoodie with the snake's head face-on: open jaws, fangs and fine tattoo linework. A stare no one forgets.
hoodie-white-head.details:
Print: face-on snake head
«ГАДЮКА / They Will Remember Me» lettering at the hem
Signature hang tag with the red tongue

hoodie-white-scales.title: Scales Hoodie — White
hoodie-white-scales.description: A white hoodie with a snake-scale pattern — GADYUKA's signature element, drawn in an engraving style.

hoodie-black-back.title: Head Hoodie — Black
hoodie-black-back.description: A black hoodie with an oversized snake head across the entire back. The statement piece for those who will be remembered.

Colour: black

seed-review-1.author: Sergey
seed-review-1.text: GADYUKA offers unique designs that are perfect for big-city life. Very happy with my purchase!

seed-review-2.author: Anna
seed-review-2.text: The hoodie fits beautifully, and the snake print gets noticed wherever I go.

seed-review-3.author: Dmitry
seed-review-3.text: I ordered a hoodie to my own measurements — the team helped with fabric and fit. The result exceeded my expectations.

kollekciya-menya-zapomnyat-v-kataloge.title: «They Will Remember Me» is now in the catalog
kollekciya-menya-zapomnyat-v-kataloge.excerpt: Four hoodies with signature tattoo graphics: the mark, a face-on snake head, scales and an oversized head on the back.
kollekciya-menya-zapomnyat-v-kataloge.body:
«They Will Remember Me» is now in the catalog. Four hoodies with GADYUKA's engraving-style graphics — from the signature mark to an oversized snake head across the back.

Every piece arrives in a numbered signature box with the red-tongue hang tag.

pop-up-v-krasnodare.title: GADYUKA pop-up in Krasnodar
pop-up-v-krasnodare.excerpt: Try the hoodies on, meet the team and talk made-to-measure. Date and venue coming soon.
pop-up-v-krasnodare.body:
We're preparing a pop-up in Krasnodar: try on pieces from «They Will Remember Me», meet the team and talk through a made-to-measure order.

Date and venue will be announced in our news and on social media.
